Chapter 20 Babe, I'm Not Mad, I'm Moving Up a Class

"Huh?" Xu Qianqian gave him a suspicious look. "For real?"

"Of course it's real, but I turned her down." Jiang Nian lied without blushing. "I don't plan on dating in my senior year, I just want to study."

These were Zhou Yuting's exact words, shamelessly plagiarized by Jiang Nian.

"Mhm, it's right for you to think that way." Xu Qianqian, walking ahead, said with a serious expression, "Once you get to university, you'll have more options. There's no need to limit yourself to a small county town."

"Aiyo, you sound like you know a lot, huh?" Jiang Nian tutted.

Xu Qianqian's face gradually reddened. "My cousin told me."

"Oh, so has your cousin found a boyfriend yet?"

"No." Xu Qianqian's voice grew softer and softer as she explained with little conviction, "My cousin is different. Her goal is graduate school."

What followed was a string of hard-to-understand phrases, like "modern independent woman" and "marrying up," instantly filling the air with cheer on their way home from evening self-study.

6, I'm from Dunhuang, I can tell it's real at a glance. Cheese snow leopard, this is a mural.

Jiang Nian burst out laughing, then said mysteriously.

"Hey, did you know? The old grandma at our village entrance is eighty and still single. And guess what? Just as she was about to breathe her last, the ground suddenly split open, and an immortal lord walked out."

"The immortal lord fed the old grandma an elixir pill, and she instantly returned to being eighteen. In the end, the two of them returned home hand in hand to become a divine couple."

"That scene, with auspicious purple energy coming from the east, red flags waving amidst a sea of people. Everyone within ten li and eight villages envied that pair. So, you should tell your cousin to hold on. She'll definitely find her soulmate."

"Don't... talk about my cousin like that." Xu Qianqian was incredibly embarrassed.

Jiang Nian said casually, "Xu Qianqian, your cousin is a dud. You should hang out with her less."

"Oh."

After getting home, Jiang Nian once again heard the sound of his parents sighing coming from their room.

But since it was already late, he felt it wasn't right to knock, so he just gave them a call directly. His mom's voice, full of vigor, roared through the door.

"Jiang Nian, are you itching for a beating! Why are you calling in the middle of the night instead of sleeping!"

"Uh, I was just curious. You two have been sighing for two nights now." Jiang Nian said, "By the way, Mom, I forgot to tell you, I scored this time..."

"Don't cause more trouble, go to sleep!"

"Oh, okay." Jiang Nian broke out in a cold sweat.

It seems something is really wrong. Otherwise, after an exam, she would always ask about his results in detail. Now she's so busy she's forgotten, so they must have run into some kind of difficult problem.

But Jiang Nian didn't take it to heart. He wouldn't meddle in his parents' affairs. If they were short on money, he could chip in a little, but he couldn't help with anything else.

In the words of Comrade Li Hongmei, getting good grades was his way of being a filial son.

Jiang Nian figured he'd wait until the class assignments were confirmed in the next couple of days to tell them. But he would ask Lao Jiang about it tomorrow to find out what was going on.

The next morning.

Click. The key turned in the old lock of the Jiang family's door. With a creak, a ray of morning light shot into the dim living room. Jiang Nian had just returned from buying breakfast.

He happened to see his own father, Comrade Lao Jiang, up early to use the bathroom, so he stopped him to ask.

"You're just a kid, why are you asking so many questions?" Lao Jiang looked bewildered, putting on a stern face in an attempt to re-establish his dignified paternal authority. "Mind your own business when it comes to adults' affairs."

"Comrade Lao Jiang, I'm already an adult."

"Still a kid."

"As a member of this family, I can even earn money." Jiang Nian lifted the bag of steamed buns in his hand and waved it. "I'm responsible for one of the family's three daily meals. It's not too much to ask for some right to know, is it?"

One's mouth is soft when eating another's food, and one's hand is short when taking another's things; the same applied even to one's own son. Lao Jiang was suddenly at a loss for words. He frowned for a moment but still told him the truth.

"It's nothing. The old family clan's ancestral hall needs to raise money for renovations."

"Chipping in money?"

"Something like that. It's not finalized yet." Lao Jiang took full charge, waving his hand. "Alright, now you know. Go to school."

"Oh." Jiang Nian suddenly felt a bit awkward. Even though he could guess the outcome, he still asked tentatively, "Is the budget tight? Why don't I contribute a little?"

Lao Jiang couldn't be bothered to reply. He just waved his hand and went into the bathroom.

Alas, the League of Worried Fathers.

Jiang Nian left the house and put the morning's events out of his mind. In any case, his words carried little weight. When it came to money, they would definitely not let him get involved, so there was no point caring.

For daily necessities, he could just subsidize the family expenses from other sources later on.

He wasn't sure if he had failed to check the almanac before leaving home, but just after parting with Xu Qianqian and turning a corner at the classroom door, he ran straight into Zhou Yuting.

"Jiang Nian." Zhou Yuting's eyes were still a bit red. She uncharacteristically took the initiative to greet him.

"Mhm, actually, I'm severely nearsighted in my left eye." Jiang Nian shuffled to the right. "And my left ear is eighty percent deaf. Classmate, who are you?"

Zhou Yuting: "...I know you're still mad at me."

The evening's melancholy, for a moment, Jiang Nian couldn't tell if she was being serious or just trolling.

Looking at her red eyes, he unexpectedly felt a bit soft-hearted. Were his words last night too harsh? She was a girl, after all.

Sigh, a girl, even an animal wouldn't be okay.

Seeing that no one in the classroom was looking their way, Jiang Nian quickly moved closer to Zhou Yuting and said gently in a bubbly, airy voice.

"Babe, I'm not mad, I'm moving up a class."

Zhou Yuting froze. Blood rushed to her head, and she nearly fainted.

"You!"

During the first period in the afternoon, the preliminary list for class promotion was released. As expected, Jiang Nian's was the only name from their class, mixed in on the sixteenth line of the list.

He was assigned to Science Olympiad Class 3, which was also class A403. Xu Qianqian's class was on the third floor, Science Olympiad Class 4, A304. Regrettably, they were not in the same class.

During evening self-study, he once again asked the head teacher for leave.

"Jiang Nian, I remember you just took leave the day before yesterday, right? Why are you asking again?"

"It's like this, my illness relapsed."

"Relapsed?"

"Yes."

The head teacher looked at the leave slip, then at his own prodigal student who was about to move up a class, and his mind was already automatically looping the BGM of "Actor".

Your act of being sick is too superficial, like a talentless actor... damn you, now you're not even bothering to act, are you!

His eyelid twitched again and again, but he finally nodded.

"Alright, be safe."

Under the cover of night, Jiang Nian cheerfully exited the school gates and pulled out his phone by the roadside to make a call.

"Zhao Jie, yes, it's me."

"Mhm, I'm on the road by the county high school. Is it convenient for you to come pick me up? Yes, that's right, for a lesson."

The four thousand he'd thrown out wasn't a complete waste. At least it came with a pick-up and drop-off service. Jiang Nian stood by the road with his arms crossed, planning to get the task done today.

When he had no money, he didn't feel the lack of it. Now that he had money, he found holes everywhere.

There weren't too many cars in the small county town. The dim yellow streetlights illuminated the entire road, as if it were covered by a pale yellow carpet.

Fifteen minutes later, a women's motorcycle pulled over by the side of the road. Zhao Qiuxue took off her helmet, smiled at Jiang Nian by the roadside, and jerked her head.

"Little handsome Jiang, get on."
